review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The position combines deep electrical engineering expertise with sophisticated simulation, compliance assessment, and technical reporting. You will work with industry-standard tools to evaluate system performance, stability, protection, and grid interconnection requirements. The role provides exposure to evolving ISO and NERC requirements within an innovative, technically driven engineering environment. Perform technical compliance assessments covering IBR facility ratings, protection coordination, ride-through capabilities, and other applicable grid requirements. Conduct modeling and compliance studies in accordance with ISO-specific requirements and applicable NERC reliability standards, including requirements such as IEEE 2800 and NERC MOD-026-2.
